key_insight: For commercial PV-plus-battery dispatch under TOU tariffs, a simple persistence-based MPC nearly matches the best achievable cost savings, while the tested RL agent fails to beat no-storage.
engineering_relevance: This suggests deployable, low-complexity model-based control can deliver most of the economic value of battery storage without requiring perfect foresight or heavy online optimization.
method: MILP with perfect foresight used as an oracle upper-bound benchmark
MPC using a day-ahead persistence forecast and prior-day data
Soft actor-critic RL trained under causal information constraints
evidence_signal: On a full-year 2023 real-world commercial PV dataset, MILP achieved a 24.6% annual cost reduction, and persistence-based MPC recovered 99.2% of that benchmark.
watch_item: The RL result is configuration- and observability-sensitive, so performance may improve with different reward design, state inputs, or training setup.
paper_title: Comparative Evaluation of MILP, MPC, and Reinforcement Learning for Commercial Battery Dispatch Under Time-of-Use Tariffs
